name: opentelemetry-operator
description: An implementation of a Kubernetes Operator, that manages collectors and auto-instrumentation of the workload using OpenTelemetry instrumentation libraries.
overview:
## For Information on Features
- [OpenTelemetry Operator for Kubernetes](https://opentelemetry.io/docs/platforms/kubernetes/operator/)

## Prerequisites and Configuration Guide
### Before you begin, ensure that you have a NKP cluster running Kubernetes version >= 1.34
### OpenTelemetry Operator requires the following applications to be installed on the NKP cluster:
- cert-manager >= v1.19.3
- kube-prometheus-stack >= 82.13.6
